title: Too small!
text: Too small!. This table is very small and cheap. You can’t hardly put anything in the drawer and not much room on the top. I don’t recommend it.

description: The c-shaped end table with drawer is a convenient and stylish piece to add to your living room with it's functionality and on-trend look. Simple in silhouette yet has a sturdy construction, this table has a spacious top to place your plate of snacks, TV remote, laptop and/or a glass of drinks. No more cluster! Thanks to the drawer, your living space will be organized at all time. You'll have a designated place for your remote control. The end table has a sleek modern style that gives your room a contemporary flair. It can be placed in your living room, family room or hall and pull it out whenever its needed. The table is perfect for any home décor as it has a classic finish and a sturdy structure. This end table is an addition of style and functionality for any home. Features: - The ''C'' Shape allows this unit to be standalone by the living room, playroom or even your bedside for easy access. - perfect addition to any smaller space. - the drawer keeps your living space organized at all time. - can accommodate a laptop, snacks, TV remote, book and/ or a glass. - modern and contemporary feel. - sturdy top and metal base. - this wonderfully useful table is a smart addition to any home.
